title: Regret Bounds for Profit Maximization in Bilateral Trade: Learning the Best Posted-Price Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2611.08173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bilateral trade models the task of intermediating between two strategic agents, a seller and a buyer, willing to trade a good for which they hold private valuations. We study this problem from the perspective of a profit-maximizing broker in a regret minimization framework. At each time step, a new seller and buyer arrive and the broker proposes a trading price to each agent. The trade happens if both agents accept, and the profit of the broker is the difference between the price received from the buyer and the one paid to the seller. At the end of each interaction, the learner only observes whether the trade occurred, and its goal is to achieve sublinear regret relative to the best fixed pair of prices in hindsight. tldr: 本文从遗憾最小化角度研究双边贸易中利润最大化经纪人问题，在只能观察交易是否发生的反馈下，为学习最优固定定价机制给出了多项式时间的次线性遗憾算法（含对抗情形）。
en_tdlr: This paper studies regret minimization for a profit-maximizing broker in bilateral trade with only trade-occurrence feedback, providing polynomial-time algorithms with sublinear regret for learning the best fixed posted-price mechanism, including in the adversarial setting.
